conceptual.description: Symmetric thematic link between two nodes — neither is subordinate to the other; they share a concept, frame, or lineage.

contains.description: Subject is a structural parent of the object — hub → child node, cluster → member, installation → exhibited component.

in-cluster.description: Runtime membership — a visitor dream or cluster-summary sits in a k-means cluster of semantically-similar prompts. Added dynamically as prompts arrive.

signal.description: Subject sends a runtime signal or data stream to the object — OSC, SSE, MIDI control, or similar inter-process channel.

training.description: Subject (dataset, photo, source) supplies training data to the object (model, artifact).

training-lora.description: Subject supplies LoRA fine-tuning data to the object. A narrower specialisation of ssd:trains used for style-transfer LoRAs (e.g., Briony watercolors).

visitor-signal.description: A visitor-originated signal path — typically the prompt pipeline from the browser interface to the live visual system.
